thread:
alexa: quick UX check: pinning a version in compare shifts focus away from the compare panel. reproducible on chrome/mac. tagging @kim + @ben. :wave:

ben: steps?

alexa: catalog -> pick two models -> Compare -> click Pin on left row. focus sometimes jumps to top nav.

kim: likely DOM reparenting. are we actually moving nodes into a pinned group?

alexa: yes, code prepends row into a pinned container. small snippet: `if (v.pinned) pinnedGroup.prepend(row)` — simple but harmful for keyboard users.

ria: clone approach suggestion: render a visual-only pinned summary at top, keep original row in DOM. clone must be inert (`aria-hidden=true`, `tabindex=-1`).

ben: engineering note: with virtualized list sticky is tricky. simpler: a `PinnedHeader` component driven by state that shows small read-only chips for pinned versions. no DOM moves.

kim: design preference: pinned header (non-interactive) + clear divider. canonical interactions stay on original rows. microcopy: button -> "Pin", tooltip -> "Pin — keep this version visible in comparisons."

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: do not reparent interactive nodes; use `role=status` to announce single message like "Pinned v1.2.3"; toasts should be `aria-live=polite` and include an Undo; clone elements must be inert; tooltips should portal to body to avoid clipping; badges need `aria-label` with numeric percentiles.

alexa: also observed perf badge tooltip gets clipped near the pinned area. mounting to body fixes it.

ben: plan: implement `PinnedHeader` + portal tooltips + scoped state updates to avoid re-rendering filter chips. will add `role=status` announcement on toggle.

kim: design asks: keep pinned header non-focusable. if pointer users click a chip, focus should jump to canonical row programmatically. keyboard users should navigate to the row normally.

ria: agree. ensure the pinned header has no tabbable elements so SRs don't see duplicates. include inline p50/p95 numbers on the badge to reduce tooltip reliance.

ben: i'll open a PR with prototype and tag @alexa for QA. logging these items in the PR checklist.

alexa: thanks. i'll run keyboard + NVDA checks when it's ready. leaving thread open for followups. :thumbsup:
